TileStructure.Forest.e764_preCS.statement: Let $X$ be a metric space, let $a\in\mathbb N$, $q\in\mathbb R$, $K:X\to X\to\mathbb C$, $\sigma_1,\sigma_2:X\to\mathbb Z$ and $F,G\subseteq X$, and assume the standing hypotheses `ProofData a q K σ₁ σ₂ F G` (which equip $X$ with the volume measure $\mu$ and the function $Q$ used below). Assume moreover a tile structure `TileStructure Q (defaultD a) (defaultκ a) (defaultS X) (cancelPt X)` on $X$, with tiles $\mathfrak P(X)$ and grid cubes $\mathrm{Grid}(X)$; write $D=\mathrm{defaultD}(a)$ and $S=\mathrm{defaultS}(X)$. (Equation (7.6.4) of Lemma 7.6.2, before applying Cauchy–Schwarz.) Let $n\in\mathbb N$, let $t$ be a forest of level $n$ (`Forest X n`), let $u_1,u_2\in\mathfrak P(X)$ with $u_1\in t$, $u_2\in t$, $u_1\ne u_2$ and $\mathcal I(u_1)\le\mathcal I(u_2)$ (where $\mathcal I(p)$ is the grid cube `𝓘 p` of a tile $p$), and let $f:X\to\mathbb C$ be bounded with compact support (with respect to $\mu$). Then $$\Big\|P\Big(\big|T^*_{\mathfrak T_t(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f\big|\Big)\Big\|_{L^2(\mu)} \le C_{2.1.3}(a)\,2^{4a}\sum_{k=\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor}^{2S}\Bigg(\sum_{J\in\mathcal J_6(u_1)}\mu(J)^{-1}\Big(\sum_{I}\int_J\mathbf 1_{B(c(I),8D^{s(I)})}(y)\,Mf(y)\,d\mu(y)\Big)^2\Bigg)^{1/2},$$ computed in $[0,\infty]$, where: $\mathcal J_6(u_1)$ is the finite set of grid cubes `t.𝓙₆ u₁`; $P$ is `Forest.approxOnCube (t.𝓙₆ u₁)`; $T^*_{\mathfrak T_t(u_2)\setminus\mathfrak S_0(u_1,u_2)}f$ is `adjointCarlesonSum (t.𝔗 u₂ \ t.𝔖₀ u₁ u₂) f`; $C_{2.1.3}(a)$ is `C2_1_3 a` and $C_{7.6.3}(a,n)$ is `Forest.C7_6_3 a n`; the outer sum runs over integers $k$ with $\lfloor C_{7.6.3}(a,n)\rfloor\le k\le 2S$; the innermost sum runs over grid cubes $I\in\mathrm{Grid}(X)$ with $s(I)=s(J)-k$, $I$ disjoint from $\mathcal I(u_1)$, and $J$ not disjoint from the ball $B(c(I),8D^{s(I)})$, where $s(I)$ and $c(I)$ are the scale and center of $I$; and $M$ is `maximalFunction volume Forest.𝓑 Forest.c𝓑 Forest.r𝓑 1` (the maximal function with respect to $\mu$ with exponent $1$ over the family `Forest.𝓑` with centers `Forest.c𝓑` and radii `Forest.r𝓑`).
